facts.statement: From January 15 to January 18, 2010 (until 11:59pm PST), SOE offered specific Free Realms items priced at 500 Station Cash on the Station Marketplace, with SOE contributing $10 toward Haiti relief per 500 SC redeemed, up to $25,000.
facts.quote: From January 15th to January 18th, players can redeem 500 station cash towards the purchase of these items and SOE will contribute $10 (up to $25,000)

article_summaries.title: Sony Online Entertainment Begins Haiti Charity Relief Drive
article_summaries.summary: SOE's announcement of a Haiti relief promotion covering EverQuest, EverQuest 2 and Free Realms. Free Realms is one of three games whose Station Marketplace items were part of the drive, so the article gives only a promotion window and a donation rate, not Free Realms-specific game content. The article does not name which Free Realms items were eligible.
